measuredToday.rationale: median room left 0.748 over 9 scored launches (8/9 clear the 0.55 bar); landing costs a median 0.043 SOL per SOL staked per launch (0.040 pooled over entries, 0.052 SOL at the median entry, p90 1.186); and after that cost the field still clears — 52/75 priced round trips positive, median 0.103 SOL NET OF MEASURED FEES against 0.153 gross. NOT a recommendation and NOT a profit claim: A LANDING TIP PAID IN A SEPARATE TRANSACTION OF THE SAME BUNDLE IS NOT IN ANY FIGURE ABOVE. It is not recoverable from the entrant's own transaction and it is not measured anywhere in this repo's ground truth either, so every cost here is a LOWER bound and every after-cost result an UPPER bound: entry looks cheaper, and the field more profitable, than either was. Exit feasibility is unmeasured entirely. This means the exit question is worth asking, and nothing more. ROOM MEDIAN 0.7477 IS INCOMPLETE: it is taken over 9 launch(es) while 1 more produced no room figure (0 REFUSED as unproven and measured, 1 never measured at all), and they did not go missing at random. Completing the sample puts the median in [0.7454, 0.7598], so this figure may overstate room by up to 0.0023. The bound is exact rather than tuned: a refused launch's measured room is a strict UPPER bound on its true room (the co-ordination rule can only under-mark on a launch it marked nothing in), an unmeasured one lies anywhere in room's algebraic support, and the median is monotone in every observation. It is REPORTED and never gated on: no refusal is relaxed by it (captain decision 208b).
